description: Remake layer: where the Nintendo Switch remake differs from the base OoT world. Each rule replaces the base rule of the location; each move puts a location in another region. Found in game or by the audit (python -m oot_rando audit).

Links Pocket.why: The base world hands the Link's Pocket reward out at the start; the remake gives it through Rauru only after the first Master Sword pull (11/10: an Ocarina placed there was counted in sphere 0).

LW Gift from Saria.why: Saria's bridge gift is only proven after the Deku Tree (the only vanilla way out of the forest); with the forest opened early the cutscene trigger is not validated in game.

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: The only Lost Woods chest (purple rupee) is not in a grotto: it stands on a ledge of the stick-scrub room that only the adult bean platform of the soil near the bridge reaches (Obj_SmallFarm_A_03 → DestinationAnchor at 2.9 m).

Market Lost Dog.rule: is_child and at_night and 'Kakariko Village Gate Open'
Market Lost Dog.why: Richard only runs away once the Kakariko gate guard has read Zelda's Letter (Logic/Market_Child_Prefab_f3a2: RunningRichard needs Npc_Hylia_Soldier_003_GateOpen); before that he stays home with his owner (14/11, Discord report).

Song from Saria.rule: is_child and Zeldas_Letter and at('GC Darunias Chamber', is_child)
Song from Saria.why: Saria teaches her song during the Fire Stone quest (Challenge Get_StoneOfFire, step SariaMelodyGet), only after Darunia asked for music in his chamber (11/11: Kokiri Sword behind the Skull Kid).

Song from Ocarina of Time.rule: is_child and has_all_stones and 'Met Zelda' and 'Dodongos Cavern Clear' and 'Jabu Jabus Belly Clear'
Song from Ocarina of Time.why: Zelda's escape and the Song of Time (Challenge DoorOfTime, after Goto_HyruleCastle) follow DoorOfTime_CheckStoneNum, run when Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly are finished: it reads both dungeon quests (Get_StoneOfFire / Get_StoneOfWater completed), not the stones held (15/11, Discord report: three stones, no cutscene before Jabu-Jabu).

Master Sword Pedestal.rule: 'Met Zelda' and 'Dodongos Cavern Clear' and 'Jabu Jabus Belly Clear'
Master Sword Pedestal.why: The Door of Time opens in the same DoorOfTime challenge: the Song of Time alone (songs shuffled) does not open it before both dungeon quests and meeting Zelda.

Met Zelda.why: Zelda in the castle garden completes Goto_HyruleCastle; Impa's send-off follows (HavePlayedEvent.Dm_HrlField_0020), which frees the clock and starts DoorOfTime.

Dodongos Cavern Clear.rule: ((can_use(Megaton_Hammer) and logic_dc_hammer_floor) or has_explosives or king_dodongo_shortcuts) and (((Bombs or Progressive_Strength_Upgrade) and can_jumpslash) or deadly_bonks == 'ohko')
Dodongos Cavern Clear.why: King Dodongo beaten (same rule as his location): the Get_StoneOfFire quest completes on the way out.

Jabu Jabus Belly Clear.why: Barinade beaten (same rule as its location): the Get_StoneOfWater quest completes on the way out.

time_of_day.why: Until Impa's send-off after Zelda (HavePlayedEvent.Dm_HrlField_0020) the remake holds the clock at 15:00 (issue #40): no night, so night-only checks (gold skulltulas, Dampé…) need Zelda first (15/11, Discord report).

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: Same chest: on a ledge of the Lost Woods, not in the grotto.
